title: bulk confirm step names a record by another text field when its nameField is not a grid column: HotCRM's contact list lists ticked contacts by job title ("VP of Engineering")
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with reach measured** (user-visible wrong text). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`, seat post objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2180) from the os-dev report on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2167 (PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2186). ⛔ Not a claim. Domain, type and grade are triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it to `plugin-grid` (the grid's `$select`) or `core` (`getRecordDisplayName`). Which of the two owns the fix is triage's call.

## What happens (measured on the 18.0.0-next.5 console, HotCRM)

- On HotCRM's **All Contacts** list, as an admin and as a marketing user, tick John Smith and Marcus Reed, then run **Add to Campaign** from the selection bar.
- The confirm step reads *"This will apply to 2 records. Affected records (2):"* and lists **• VP of Engineering** and **• Director of Commercial Systems**. Those are the two contacts' job titles (`title`), not their names. This was measured 2 of 2.
- The lead list's confirm step names leads correctly.

## Why (read at objectui `61ed5ada`)

- `crm_contact` declares `nameField: 'full_name'`, a formula field. The All Contacts view's columns are `first_name`, `last_name`, `title` and others. `full_name` is not among them.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx` (confirm step, about line 478) names each row with `getRecordDisplayName(objectDef, r, …)` over the **grid row**. That row holds only the columns the grid fetched, so the declared `full_name` is absent.
- `packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts` `getRecordDisplayName` then falls past the declared rung (1+2) to step 4, `deriveTitleField(objectDef)`, or to step 4b, whose name-ish record keys include `title`. Either path resolves a *different* text field. For a CRM contact, `title` is the job title.
- So any object whose `nameField` is not a column gets its affected records named by whatever other field the ladder derives. A wrong name in a confirm step for a write is worse than the `Record #id` floor.

## Precedents and related (all closed)

- objectui#12332 replaced the raw ids in this step with the ADR-0079 resolver. That is the call that now reads the grid row.
- objectui#5217 harvested `recordIdField` into the grid's `$select`, because a field the row needs was not a column.
- objectui#7245: a synthesized default list view omitted the `nameField`.

## Acceptance (proposed, for triage to own)

- The confirm step names every affected record by its declared `nameField` value, whether or not that field is a column of the view. Either the grid fetches the `nameField`, or the step resolves the names itself.
- When the declared `nameField` cannot be read, the step does not substitute another text field's value.

## Dedupe (objectui issues, all states, semantic search)

- "bulk action confirm dialog affected records shows wrong display name, nameField not in grid columns, falls back to title field": 8 hits shown of 17. The nearest are #12332, #12105 and #7245, all closed; none covers a nameField missing from the row.
- "getRecordDisplayName grid row missing nameField $select formula full_name record title job title": 6 hits. #13103 is open, on a select nameField's option label, which is a different rung. #5217 and #6531 are closed. None is on point.

Dedupe words: BulkActionDialog affected records; nameField not in columns; $select nameField harvest; getRecordDisplayName deriveTitleField title; contact job title in confirm step.
